method:
Certify positive digit mesh separation along piecewise-linear joint intervals.

Triangle inequality bounds each geometry's Hausdorff motion from interval midpoint
by the sum of ancestor angular changes times configuration-independent radii.
Shared ancestors cancel because distance is invariant to a shared rigid motion.
boundary: Certifies authored triangle meshes under piecewise-linear joint interpolation, not PhysX convex shape equivalence or unknown within-step physical states.
